description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 27.09.2021 to 03.10.2021
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is for authority purposes only and does not constitute a government personnel appointment or describe portfolio responsibilities.
